command_template: PYTHONPATH=packages/jev-prose/src python3 -m jev_prose.cli check DRAFT --profile formal --threshold 0.90 --audience "software engineers" --voice "professional technical prose"
limitations: Three deliberately selected passages, not an independent accuracy benchmark.
Model-clean means no questions passed the fixed threshold, not absence of editorial problems.
Passage A retains observable generic promotional prose after the skill stops on a clean report.
Passage C changes the unsupported conclusion while preserving observational facts; literal claim preservation would instead require leaving and disclosing the overclaim.
setup_observations: An initial unconfigured python3 module-help call could not import the package; the instructed PYTHONPATH resolved it. This was an invocation setup error, not a CLI defect.

passages.original: In today's rapidly evolving landscape, our groundbreaking export feature stands as a testament to innovation. It is important to note that the feature can export up to 500 rows in CSV format, underscoring our commitment to seamless productivity. Exports omit archived rows.
passages.final: Our groundbreaking export feature stands as a testament to innovation. The feature can export up to 500 rows in CSV format, underscoring our commitment to seamless productivity. Exports omit archived rows.

meaning_assessment.method: Writer comparison of exact original and final text, observations, conditions, numerical limits, and conclusion strength.
meaning_assessment.fact_preservation: All supplied observational and behavioral facts retained.
changes: Removed the generic era-opening clause after era-opener feedback.
Removed It is important to note that after importance-windup feedback.
preserved_facts: The export feature supports up to 500 rows.
claim_changes: Removed generic changing-landscape framing; no concrete product claim changed.
unresolved_editorial_issues: The model-clean final still calls the feature groundbreaking and a testament to innovation without a specific innovation claim.
The trailing underscoring our commitment to seamless productivity remains generic promotional commentary. Both issues remained below the fixed threshold; the skill stopped on a clean report.

checks.text: In today's rapidly evolving landscape, our groundbreaking export feature stands as a testament to innovation. It is important to note that the feature can export up to 500 rows in CSV format, underscoring our commitment to seamless productivity. Exports omit archived rows.

findings.title: Generic era opener
findings.question: Does the prose open with generic era framing such as in today's rapidly changing world rather than name a specific relevant circumstance?
findings.guidance: Lead with the actual claim or the specific circumstance already provided.

findings.title: Importance windup
findings.question: Does the prose announce that a fact is important to note or worth noting before stating it, where deleting that announcement would preserve the information?
findings.guidance: State the fact directly; retain any substantive reason it matters.

checks.text: Our groundbreaking export feature stands as a testament to innovation. The feature can export up to 500 rows in CSV format, underscoring our commitment to seamless productivity. Exports omit archived rows.

passages.final: The pilot involved eight users. Five completed the task without help. The pilot does not establish whether every new user will succeed.

meaning_assessment.method: Writer comparison of exact original and final text, observations, conditions, numerical limits, and conclusion strength.
meaning_assessment.fact_preservation: All supplied observational and behavioral facts retained.
changes: Replaced the unsupported universal proof claim with an explicit statement that the pilot does not establish universal success.
preserved_facts: Five completed the task without help.
claim_changes: The final deliberately narrows the conclusion: universal success is no longer asserted. This is an evidential-calibration correction prompted by proof-overclaim, not a claim of identical semantics. No observational fact was removed or invented.

findings.title: Proof stronger than stated evidence
findings.question: Does the prose claim proof or certainty from evidence it explicitly describes as limited observations, a small sample, or anecdotal reports?
findings.guidance: Match the conclusion's certainty to the evidence actually described.
